Lemon Barley Salad

A bright grain salad for warm days.

Recipe Source: Test Kitchen Book

Ingredients

  • 1 C cooked barley
  • 2 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 1/4 tsp salt

Directions

  1. Toss the barley with the lemon juice and salt.
  2. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

Prep Time

10 minutes

Yields

4 servings

Nutritional Facts

Calories

120
